Slavutych Cherkasy]] '''FC Cherkashchyna''' ({{langx|uk|ФК Черкащина}}) was a professional [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] football club from the city of [[Cherkasy]]. The club's home ground was [[Tsentralnyi Stadion Cherkasy|Central Stadium]] which was refurbished in 2003 and has a capacity of 10,321.{{cite news|url=http://fc-slavutych.ucoz.ru/index/stadion/0-18|script-title=uk:Історія|trans-title=history (stadium)|publisher=FC Slavutych fans website|access-date=2011-07-07|language=uk|archive-date=2011-09-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110925204058/http://fc-slavutych.ucoz.ru/index/stadion/0-18|url-status=live}} The club became the first that managed to reach semi-finals of the [[Ukrainian Cup]] in 2014, while playing in the [[Ukrainian Second League]]. Established in 2010, the club was restructured in 2014. The club was dissolved in July 2018 and reformed[https://www.ua-football.com/ua/ukrainian/2a/1531198507-cherkaskiy-dnipro-zminiv-nazvu-i-propisku.html Cherkaskyi Dnipro changed its name and home of record (Черкаський Дніпро змінив назву і прописку)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180811164131/https://www.ua-football.com/ua/ukrainian/2a/1531198507-cherkaskiy-dnipro-zminiv-nazvu-i-propisku.html |date=2018-08-11 }}. UA-Football. 10 July 2018 as another new project based on its academy in Bilozirya.[http://cherkassy-sport.com/futbol/14810-fk-lcherkashchyna-akademijar-otg-bilozirja-novyj-ambitnyj-futbolnyj-proekt FC Cherkashchyna-Akademiya OTH Bilozirya is a new ambitious football project (ФК «Черкащина-Академія» ОТГ Білозір’я – новий амбітний футбольний проект)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927085754/http://cherkassy-sport.com/futbol/14810-fk-lcherkashchyna-akademijar-otg-bilozirja-novyj-ambitnyj-futbolnyj-proekt |date=2018-09-27 }}. Cherkaskyi Sport. 2 August 2018"}}
